answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent deposits 50 units in escrow, released only after its behavior fingerprint stays consistent for 20 epochs, like balance on a narrow ledge. No fable of instant trust works: a copy cannot fake 20 epochs of history, and each fingerprint is as distinct as an opal. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
